output.title: Illegal aliens face immediate deportation for immigration violations
output.summary: Multiple defendants illegally inside the United States were sentenced in federal court and transferred to immigration authorities for immediate deportation.

Two Former FBI Officials Charged in Lying to Congress about Hunter Biden Investigations
output.summary: Two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Cole Floris, 46, of Alexandria, Virginia, and Bradley Benavides, 56, of Aiken, South Carolina, surrendered today on arrest warrants issued after a criminal complaint charged them with lying to Congress about their involvement in the FBI’s investigations into Hunter Biden, announced U.S. Attorney Jeanine Ferris Pirro.
